statement: 有限非空集合Dと a* in D に対し、C(f,a*,D)=0 ⟺ a* in argmax_{a in D} f(a)
scope: 有限非空集合D、実数値関数f、a*∈D。C=max(f(a)-f(a*))。最大値の存在とargmaxの定義を前提とする。

axioms: Finite nonempty real-valued functions attain a maximum.
argmax membership means f(x)<=f(a*) for all x in D.
check.limit: Checker verifies linear obligations under the explicit maximum/argmax encoding; not arbitrary Japanese theorem understanding.
